CustomField.description: Where this component is filed in the component browser, as folder names joined with a slash, such as Grants/Applications. Folders exist only as this path; there is no separate folder record. Forms built from custom metadata store the same value in their configuration. Long text, so it cannot be used in a query filter.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Folder names joined with a slash, such as Grants/Applications.
CustomField.label: Folder
